_meta.description: Submit a prompt to Google Gemini and capture the response.

prompt.description: The prompt/question to send to Gemini
prompt.hint: Can be any length. For multi-line, use newlines in the string.

base_url.description: URL to navigate to before submitting. Use default for new conversation.
base_url.hint: Can point to an existing Gemini conversation to continue a thread

params.prompt: Say hello in exactly one sentence.

chain.note: Navigate the (authenticated) tab to base_url. Added 2026-07-09 WQ-164 — recipe had no navigate step so it ran against the wrong active tab. Default base_url=gemini.google.com/app is a fresh single-turn chat, keeping the s7 read reliable.
wait for prompt_input before next step (was delay 800ms)
Type prompt only. Gemini does NOT submit on Enter (verified 2026-07-09 WQ-164) — needs the Send button click (s3c).
Send button enables once the prompt has text
Submit the prompt (WQ-164: replaces Enter-submit, which gemini ignores)
wait for the response element to appear (streaming started). Healed 2026-07-09 WQ-164: [aria-label='Stop response'] not reliably observable.

Wait until the response toolbar (Good/Bad/Copy) appears — generation complete. Healed 2026-07-09 WQ-164 (replaces unverified [aria-label='Stop response']). base_url=/app is single-turn so the toolbar means THIS response is done.
settle (was delay 500ms); resolves on content root, proceeds on timeout
Capture the model response. Healed 2026-07-09 WQ-164: .model-response-text is the clean body (verified live); .markdown / message-content fallbacks.
